cohort: Case records of all postpartum eclampsia patients admitted to a tertiary care hospital in Davangere between January 2021 to December 2023 were analyzed.
finding: The incidence of postpartum eclampsia was 9.3 per 1000 deliveries, frequently occurring in the 21-25 age group and primi-para, with seizures commonly observed between 48 hours to 7 days postpartum.
mod_finding: The commonest mode of delivery among patients with postpartum eclampsia was vaginal route (63%).
